name: 10595-longprefill-qwen3next80b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, bf16. Do not substitute a smaller Qwen3-Next: none has the same layer mix at this depth.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, half of one a3 node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism.
architecture: Qwen3NextForCausalLM: 48 layers on full_attention_interval 4, so 12 full-attention and 36 gated-DeltaNet linear-attention layers; sparse MoE, 512 experts at top-10; 80B parameters, ~3B active per token, ~160 GB of weights (~40 GB per card at TP4).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 384 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: 32684 prompt tokens (stdev 0) against exactly 100 output tokens (stdev 0). Seed 10595.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing 32,000-token reports into short answers for 32 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# `sglang serve` arguments for commit 6fd4816d9f1ae31124139e6a6bfb20b141694e9b.
#
# FLAT PARSER: one `key: value` per line. A nested or indented block is DROPPED silently, and the
# engine then starts without something this file claims to declare.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct
tp-size: 4
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
cuda-graph-max-bs: 32
random-seed: 10595
